title: Prevent a cache stampede
subtitle: Avoid sending every cache miss to your database
learning_objective: Explain cache stampedes and compare single-flight, TTL jitter, and stale-while-revalidate.

scenes.title: THE CACHE EXPIRES
scenes.body: A popular key expires. Thousands of requests miss at once and hammer the database.

scenes.title: One miss becomes a thundering herd
scenes.body: When many callers rebuild the same expired value simultaneously, the cache can create a burst of duplicate expensive work.

scenes.title: Coordinate refreshes
items: Others wait or use stale value

scenes.title: Choose a defense
scenes.body: Single-flight coalesces concurrent refreshes; TTL jitter spreads expirations; stale-while-revalidate can serve an old value while refreshing when the product permits it.

scenes.question: Which technique helps prevent many callers from rebuilding the same key at once?
options: Expiring every key at the same instant
scenes.explanation: Single-flight coordinates concurrent work so one refresh happens for a key while other callers share the result or wait.

scenes.title: Remember this
scenes.body: A cache needs an expiry strategy and a plan for concurrent misses—not just a TTL.
